newsitem.title: USA: California Financial extends merger vote.
newsitem.headline: California Financial extends merger vote.

text.p: California Financial Holding Company, parent company for Stockton Savings Bank, said it has extended the election deadline for its merger with Temple-Inland Inc to 1700 PDT/2000 EDT on June 9, 1997.

Separately, California Financial said Temple-Inland has received approval from the Office of Thrift Supervision to acquire California Financial and merge Stockton Savings Bank with its unit, Guaranty Federal Bank.
In a statement issued late on Friday, California Financial said its shareholders approved the acquisition and merger on April 28. The deal is expected to close on or about June 27.
